format.description: ADSP-2106x extended float: 8-bit exponent and 32-bit significand including the hidden bit

vectors.name: fadd_preserves_extended_lsb
vectors.reason: 40-bit mode must retain the low extended mantissa bit

vectors.name: fadd_rnd32_clears_input_and_output_lsb
vectors.reason: RND32 clears each input's eight extended bits and the result's eight low bits

vectors.name: fmul_preserves_extended_lsb
vectors.reason: multiplication by one must not discard a representable extended bit

vectors.name: fmul_rnd32_clears_input_and_output_lsb
vectors.reason: RND32 applies to multiplier inputs as well as its destination

vectors.name: fadd_negative_preserves_extended_lsb
vectors.reason: the signed 40-bit path must retain extended precision for negative results

vectors.name: fmul_negative_preserves_extended_lsb
vectors.reason: multiplication must preserve both sign and a representable extended bit

vectors.name: fadd_nearest_even_tie_down
vectors.reason: a halfway result keeps the even extended significand

vectors.name: fadd_nearest_even_tie_up
vectors.reason: a halfway result rounds an odd extended significand upward

vectors.name: fadd_truncate_tie
vectors.reason: TRUNC selects round-toward-zero at the 40-bit boundary

vectors.name: fmul_wide_significand_does_not_wrap
vectors.reason: two 33-bit significands require a 66-bit product before 40-bit normalization

vectors.name: fmul_wide_significand_rnd32_does_not_wrap
vectors.reason: RND32 still requires a wide product before the 24-bit destination boundary

vectors.name: fadd_far_exponent_does_not_overflow_alignment
vectors.reason: an exponent gap beyond the destination precision must not wrap a uint64 alignment shift

vectors.name: float_3_is_always_extended_boundary
vectors.reason: fixed-point-to-float conversion uses the 40-bit boundary even with RND32
